instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a sunny park with green trees, four children stand side-by-side in a friendly huddle. On the far left, the boy with glasses in a yellow t-shirt (R1) stands facing forward, smiling. Next to him, the girl with curly hair in a brown dress and white cardigan (R3) smiles warmly. Beside her, the boy in a blue denim shirt (R5) smiles. On the far right, the girl with dark hair and bangs in a striped dress and dark cardigan (R4) smiles happily. They have their arms wrapped around each other's shoulders. Warm, bright sunlight filters through the trees from behind, creating a soft backlighting effect.
